verses.en: Thanks be to thy name, O Lord God of Israel, who keepest covenant and showest mercy unto thy servants who walk uprightly before thee, with all their hearts—
verses.sm: Faafetai i lou suafa, Le Alii e le Atua o Isaraelu, o lē e tausia feagaiga ma faailoa mai le alofa mutimutivale i au auauna o e savavali sa’o i ou luma, ma o latou loto atoa—

verses.en: Thou who hast commanded thy servants to build a house to thy name in this place [Kirtland].
verses.sm: O oe o le na poloaiina au auauna e fausia se fale i lou suafa i lenei nofoaga [o Katelani].

verses.en: And now thou beholdest, O Lord, that thy servants have done according to thy commandment.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ua e silasila mai, Le Alii e, ua faia e au auauna e tusa ma lau poloaiga.

verses.en: And now we ask thee, Holy Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, the Son of thy bosom, in whose name alone salvation can be administered to the children of men, we ask thee, O Lord, to accept of this house, the workmanship of the hands of us, thy servants, which thou didst command us to build.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei matou te ole atu ia te oe, Le Tamā Paia e, i le suafa o Iesu Keriso, le Alo o lou loto, o lē ua na o lona suafa lava e mafai ona tuuina mai ai le faaolataga i le fanauga a tagata, matou te ole atu ia te oe, Le Alii e, ia e talia lenei fale, o le galuega a o matou lima, o au auauna, lea na e poloaiina i matou e fausia.

verses.en: For thou knowest that we have done this work through great tribulation; and out of our poverty we have given of our substance to build a house to thy name, that the Son of Man might have a place to manifest himself to his people.
verses.sm: Aua ua e silafia na matou faia lenei galuega i le puapuaga tele; ma ua matou tuuina atu mai lo matou mativa ni a matou mea e fausia ai se fale i lou suafa, ina ia i ai se nofoaga e mafai e le Atalii o le Tagata ona faaali mai ai o ia lava i lona nuu.

verses.en: And as thou hast said in a revelation, given to us, calling us thy friends, saying—Call your solemn assembly, as I have commanded you;
verses.sm: Ma e pei ona sa e fetalai mai i se faaaliga, na tuuina mai ia te i matou, na ta’ua ai i matou o au uo, ua fetalai mai— Ia talo la outou faapotopotoga paia, e pei ona Ou poloaiina ai outou;

verses.en: And as all have not faith, seek ye diligently and teach one another words of wisdom; yea, seek ye out of the best books words of wisdom, seek learning even by study and also by faith;
verses.sm: Ma ona e lē i ai i tagata uma le faatuatua, ia outou saili ma le filiga ma aoao e le tasi le isi upu o le poto; ioe, ia outou saili mai tusi sili ona lelei upu o le poto, ia saili aoaoga e ala lava i le suesue ma le faatuatua foi;

verses.en: Organize yourselves; prepare every needful thing, and establish a house, even a house of prayer, a house of fasting, a house of faith, a house of learning, a house of glory, a house of order, a house of God;
verses.sm: Ia faatulaga tatau outou lava; ia saunia mea manaomia uma, ma faatuina se fale, o se fale lava o le tatalo, o se fale o le anapogi, o se fale o le faatuatua, o se fale o le aoaoga, o se fale o le mamalu, o se fale o le faatulagaga tatau, o se maota o le Atua;

verses.en: That your incomings may be in the name of the Lord, that your outgoings may be in the name of the Lord, that all your salutations may be in the name of the Lord, with uplifted hands unto the Most High—
verses.sm: Ina ia faia i le suafa o le Alii a outou ulufale mai, ina ia faia i le suafa o le Alii a outou ulufafo atu, ina ia faia a outou faafeiloaiga uma i le suafa o le Alii, ma lima ua siitia a’e i le Silisili Ese—

verses.en: And now, Holy Father, we ask thee to assist us, thy people, with thy grace, in calling our solemn assembly, that it may be done to thine honor and to thy divine acceptance;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, Le Tamā Paia e, matou te ole atu ia te oe ia fesoasoani mai ia te i matou, o lou nuu, i lou alofa tunoa, i le taloina o la matou faapotopotoga paia, ina ia faia mo lou mamalu ma mo lou taliaina i le paia;

verses.en: And in a manner that we may be found worthy, in thy sight, to secure a fulfilment of the promises which thou hast made unto us, thy people, in the revelations given unto us;
verses.sm: Ma i se ala e mafai ai ona maua i matou ua agavaa, i lau silafaga, e maua ai se faataunuuga o folafolaga na e faia mai ia te i matou, o lou nuu, i faaaliga ua tuuina mai ia te i matou;

verses.en: That thy glory may rest down upon thy people, and upon this thy house, which we now dedicate to thee, that it may be sanctified and consecrated to be holy, and that thy holy presence may be continually in this house;
verses.sm: Ina ia to’a mai i luga o lou nuu lou mamalu, ma i luga o lou maota nei, lea ua matou tuu atu nei i lau afio, ina ia faapaiaina ma faamanuiaina ia paia, ma ia i ai pea le paia o lau afio i lenei fale;

verses.en: And that all people who shall enter upon the threshold of the Lord’s house may feel thy power, and feel constrained to acknowledge that thou hast sanctified it, and that it is thy house, a place of thy holiness.
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai e tagata uma e ulufale mai i le faitotoa o le maota o le Alii ona lagona lou mana, ma lagona uunaia ai e tautino atu ua e faapaiaina lenei fale, ma o lou maota lava, o se afioaga mo lou paia.

verses.en: And do thou grant, Holy Father, that all those who shall worship in this house may be taught words of wisdom out of the best books, and that they may seek learning even by study, and also by faith, as thou hast said;
verses.sm: Ma ia e tuuina mai, Le Tamā Paia e, ia aoaoina e i latou uma o e e tapuai atu i lenei fale upu o le poto mai tusi sili ona lelei, ma ina ia latou saili le aoaoina e ala lava i le suesue, ma ala foi i le faatuatua, e pei ona e fetalai mai;

verses.en: And that they may grow up in thee, and receive a fulness of the Holy Ghost, and be organized according to thy laws, and be prepared to obtain every needful thing;
verses.sm: Ma ina ia latou tutupu a’e ia te oe, ma maua le atoatoaga o le Agaga Paia, ma faatulagaina e tusa ma au tulafono, ma saunia e maua mea manaomia uma;

verses.en: And that this house may be a house of prayer, a house of fasting, a house of faith, a house of glory and of God, even thy house;
verses.sm: Ma ina ia avea lenei fale o se fale o le tatalo, o se fale o le anapogi, o se fale o le faatuatua, o se fale o le mamalu ma o le Atua, o lou maota lava;

verses.en: That all the incomings of thy people, into this house, may be in the name of the Lord;
verses.sm: Ina ia faia i le suafa o le Alii le ulufale mai uma o lou nuu, i totonu o lenei fale;

verses.en: That all their outgoings from this house may be in the name of the Lord;
verses.sm: Ina ia faia i le suafa o le Alii a latou ulufafo atu uma mai lenei fale;

verses.en: And that all their salutations may be in the name of the Lord, with holy hands, uplifted to the Most High;
verses.sm: Ma ina ia faia i le suafa o le Alii a latou fefaafeiloaiga uma, ma lima paia, ua siitia a’e i le Silisili Ese;

verses.en: And that no unclean thing shall be permitted to come into thy house to pollute it;
verses.sm: Ma ia leai se mea ’eleelea e faatagaina e oo mai i totonu o lou maota e faaeleeleaina ai;

verses.en: And when thy people transgress, any of them, they may speedily repent and return unto thee, and find favor in thy sight, and be restored to the blessings which thou hast ordained to be poured out upon those who shall reverence thee in thy house.
verses.sm: Ma a solitulafono lou nuu, soo se tasi o i latou, ia vave ona latou salamo ma toe foi mai ia te oe, ma talia i lau silafaga, ma toefuatai i faamanuiaga ua e faauuina e liligi ifo i luga o i latou o e migao i lau afio i lou maota.

verses.en: And we ask thee, Holy Father, that thy servants may go forth from this house armed with thy power, and that thy name may be upon them, and thy glory be round about them, and thine angels have charge over them;
verses.sm: Ma e matou te ole atu ia te oe, Le Tamā Paia e, ina ia o atu au auauna mai lenei fale ua faaauupegaina i lou mana, ma ina ia i ai lou suafa i luga o i latou, ma i ai lou mamalu e siosiomia i latou, ma i ai i au agelu le tausiga i o latou luga;

verses.en: And from this place they may bear exceedingly great and glorious tidings, in truth, unto the ends of the earth, that they may know that this is thy work, and that thou hast put forth thy hand, to fulfil that which thou hast spoken by the mouths of the prophets, concerning the last days.
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai ona latou tauaao atu mai lenei nofoaga tala silisili ma mamalu naua, i le upumoni, i tuluiga o le lalolagi, ina ia latou iloa o lau galuega lenei, ma ua e tuu mai lou aao, e faataunuu le mea na e fetalai mai e ala mai i fofoga o perofeta, e faatatau i aso e gata ai.

verses.en: We ask thee, Holy Father, to establish the people that shall worship, and honorably hold a name and standing in this thy house, to all generations and for eternity;
verses.sm: Matou te ole atu i lau afio, Le Tamā Paia e, ia e faatumauina tagata o le a tapuai atu, ma umia i le mamalu se igoa ma se tulaga i lou maota nei, i tupulaga uma ma mo le faavavau;

verses.en: That no weapon formed against them shall prosper; that he who diggeth a pit for them shall fall into the same himself;
verses.sm: Ina ia leai se auupega e gaosia e faasaga mai ia te i latou e manumalo; ina ia pa’ū i le lua o ia lava o lē e elia se lua mo i latou;

verses.en: That no combination of wickedness shall have power to rise up and prevail over thy people upon whom thy name shall be put in this house;
verses.sm: Ina ia leai se pulega o le amioleaga na te maua le mana e tulai a’e ai ma manumalo i luga o lou nuu o e o le a tuuina i ai lou suafa i lenei fale;

verses.en: And if any people shall rise against this people, that thine anger be kindled against them;
verses.sm: Ma afai e tulai mai soo se nuu e faasaga mai i lenei nuu, ia faamumūina lou toasa e faasaga ia te i latou;

verses.en: And if they shall smite this people thou wilt smite them; thou wilt fight for thy people as thou didst in the day of battle, that they may be delivered from the hands of all their enemies.
verses.sm: Ma afai latou te taiaina lenei nuu ia e taiaina i latou; ia e tau mo lou nuu e pei ona e faia i le aso o le taua, ina ia laveaiina i latou mai lima o o latou fili uma.

verses.en: We ask thee, Holy Father, to confound, and astonish, and to bring to shame and confusion, all those who have spread lying reports abroad, over the world, against thy servant or servants, if they will not repent, when the everlasting gospel shall be proclaimed in their ears;
verses.sm: Matou te ole atu i lau afio, Le Tamā Paia e, ia faafememea’i, ma faameia, ma faamaasiasi ma faafenumia’i i latou uma o e ua faasalalauina tala pepelo i le lautele, i luga o le lalolagi, e faasaga i lau auauna po o au auauna, pe afai latou te lē salamo, pe a folafola atu le talalelei tumau e faavavau i o latou taliga;

verses.en: And that all their works may be brought to naught, and be swept away by the hail, and by the judgments which thou wilt send upon them in thine anger, that there may be an end to lyings and slanders against thy people.
verses.sm: Ma ina ia aumai a latou galuega uma ia ma faameanoaina, ma tafi ese e le uato’a, ma le faamasinoga o le a e auina atu i o latou luga i lou toasa, ina ia i ai se iuga i pepelo ma upu taufaaleaga e faasaga i lou nuu.

verses.en: For thou knowest, O Lord, that thy servants have been innocent before thee in bearing record of thy name, for which they have suffered these things.
verses.sm: Aua ua e silafia, Le Alii e, ua mamā lava au auauna i ou luma i le molimau atu o lou suafa, lea ua latou mafatia ai i nei mea.

verses.en: Therefore we plead before thee for a full and complete deliverance from under this yoke;
verses.sm: O lea matou te aioi atu ai i ou luma mo se lavea’iga atoa ma o’oo’o mai le mafatia o lenei avega;

verses.en: Break it off, O Lord; break it off from the necks of thy servants, by thy power, that we may rise up in the midst of this generation and do thy work.
verses.sm: Ia gauia ese, le Alii e; ia gauia ese mai ūa o au auauna, i lou mana, ina ia mafai ona matou tutulai atu i luga i le lotolotoi o lenei tupulaga ma fai lau galuega.

verses.en: O Jehovah, have mercy upon this people, and as all men sin, forgive the transgressions of thy people, and let them be blotted out forever.
verses.sm: E, Ieova e, ia e alofa mutimutivale mai i lenei nuu, ma ona e agasala tagata uma, ia faamagalo mai soligatulafono a lou nuu, ma ia tuu ia solitulafono ia soloiesea e faavavau.

verses.en: Let the anointing of thy ministers be sealed upon them with power from on high.
verses.sm: Ia tuu i le faauuga o au auauna ia faamauina i o latou luga i le mana mai lugā.

verses.en: Let it be fulfilled upon them, as upon those on the day of Pentecost; let the gift of tongues be poured out upon thy people, even cloven tongues as of fire, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia faataunuuina i luga o i latou, e pei o i o latou luga i le aso o le Penetekoso; ia tuu le meaalofa o gagana ia liligi ifo i luga o lou nuu, o laulaufaiva ua vaeluaina lava e pei o le afi, ma lona faaliliuga.

verses.en: And let thy house be filled, as with a rushing mighty wind, with thy glory.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu i lou maota ia faatumuina, i lou mamalu, e peiseai o se matagi malosi ua agi tele mai.

verses.en: Put upon thy servants the testimony of the covenant, that when they go out and proclaim thy word they may seal up the law, and prepare the hearts of thy saints for all those judgments thou art about to send, in thy wrath, upon the inhabitants of the earth, because of their transgressions, that thy people may not faint in the day of trouble.
verses.sm: Tuu i luga o au auauna le molimau o le feagaiga, ina a latou o atu ma folafola atu lau afioga ia mafai ona latou faamauina le tulafono, ma saunia loto o lau au paia mo faamasinoga uma ua toetoe ona e auina mai, i lou toasa, i luga o e o nonofo i le lalolagi, ona o a latou solitulafono, ina ia lē lotovaivai lou nuu i le aso o faalavelave.

verses.en: And whatsoever city thy servants shall enter, and the people of that city receive their testimony, let thy peace and thy salvation be upon that city; that they may gather out of that city the righteous, that they may come forth to Zion, or to her stakes, the places of thine appointment, with songs of everlasting joy;
verses.sm: Ma o soo se aai e ulufale atu i ai au auauna, ma talia e tagata o lena aai la latou molimau, ia tuu lou filemu ma lau faaolataga ia i ai i luga o lena aai, ina ia mafai ona latou faapotopotoina mai lena aai e amiotonu, ina ia mafai ona latou o mai i Siona, po o i ona siteki, o nofoaga ua e tofia, ma viiga o le olioli tumau e faavavau;

verses.en: And until this be accomplished, let not thy judgments fall upon that city.
verses.sm: Ma ia lē tuuina atu au faamasinoga ia pa’u’ū ifo i luga o lena aai, seia faataunuuina lenei mea.

verses.en: And whatsoever city thy servants shall enter, and the people of that city receive not the testimony of thy servants, and thy servants warn them to save themselves from this untoward generation, let it be upon that city according to that which thou hast spoken by the mouths of thy prophets.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se aai e ulu atu i ai au auauna, ma lē talia e tagata o lena aai le molimau a au auauna, ma ua lapataiina i latou e au auauna ina ia latou faasaoina i latou lava mai lenei tupulaga faapi’opi’o, ia tuu ia oo mai i luga o lena aai e tusa ma lena na e fetalaia i fofoga o au perofeta.

verses.en: But deliver thou, O Jehovah, we beseech thee, thy servants from their hands, and cleanse them from their blood.
verses.sm: Ae ia e laveaiina, Ieova e, matou te aioi atu ai ia te oe, au auauna mai o latou lima, ma faamamā i latou mai lo latou toto.

verses.en: O Lord, we delight not in the destruction of our fellow men; their souls are precious before thee;
verses.sm: E, le Alii e, matou te lē fiafia i le faaumatiaina o o matou uso-a-tagata; ua pele lava o latou agaga i ou luma;

verses.en: But thy word must be fulfilled. Help thy servants to say, with thy grace assisting them: Thy will be done, O Lord, and not ours.
verses.sm: Ae e ao lava ona faataunuuina o lau afioga. Fesoasoani i au auauna e fai atu, faatasi ma le fesoasoani o lou alofa tunoa ia te i latou: Ia faia lou finagalo, le Alii e, ae lē o matou loto.

verses.en: We know that thou hast spoken by the mouth of thy prophets terrible things concerning the wicked, in the last days—that thou wilt pour out thy judgments, without measure;
verses.sm: Ua matou iloa ua e fetalai mai e ala i fofoga o au auauna i mea mata’utia e faatatau i e amioleaga, i aso e gata ai— o le a e faamatuu mai au faamasinoga, e aunoa ma se fuaina;

verses.en: Therefore, O Lord, deliver thy people from the calamity of the wicked; enable thy servants to seal up the law, and bind up the testimony, that they may be prepared against the day of burning.
verses.sm: O lea, le Alii e, laveai lou nuu mai le mala o e amioleaga; fai ia mafai e au auauna ona faamau le tulafono, ma fusimau le molimau, ina ia mafai ona saunia i latou mo le aso o le susunuina.

verses.en: We ask thee, Holy Father, to remember those who have been driven by the inhabitants of Jackson county, Missouri, from the lands of their inheritance, and break off, O Lord, this yoke of affliction that has been put upon them.
verses.sm: Matou te ole atu ia te oe, Le Tamā Paia e, ia e manatua i latou o e ua tulia e tagata o le itumalo o Siakisone, Misuri, mai laueleele o o latou tofi, ma ia gausia ese, le Alii e, lenei amo o le puapuaga ua tuu i o latou luga.

verses.en: Thou knowest, O Lord, that they have been greatly oppressed and afflicted by wicked men; and our hearts flow out with sorrow because of their grievous burdens.
verses.sm: Ua e silafia, le Alii e, ua matua sauaina ma faapuapuagatiaina tele i latou e tagata amioleaga; ma ua masuasua atu o matou loto i le faanoanoa ona o a latou avega mamafa.

verses.en: O Lord, how long wilt thou suffer this people to bear this affliction, and the cries of their innocent ones to ascend up in thine ears, and their blood come up in testimony before thee, and not make a display of thy testimony in their behalf?
verses.sm: Le Alii e, o le a ea le umi e te tuu ai lenei nuu e tauave lenei puapuaga, ma tagi a o latou tagata mamā e o a’e i luga i ou fofoga faalogo, ma alu a’e i luga lo latou toto o se molimau i ou luma, ma ’e lē faia se faaaliga o lau molimau mo i latou?

verses.en: Have mercy, O Lord, upon the wicked mob, who have driven thy people, that they may cease to spoil, that they may repent of their sins if repentance is to be found;
verses.sm: Ia e alofa mutimutivale, le Alii e, i luga o le vaega o tagata amioleaga, o e ua tulia ou tagata, ina ia latou taofi le faomea, ina ia latou salamo ia latou agasala pe afai e mafai ona maua le salamo;

verses.en: But if they will not, make bare thine arm, O Lord, and redeem that which thou didst appoint a Zion unto thy people.
verses.sm: Ae afai latou te lē fia salamo, ia faaalia lou aao, le Alii e, ma laveai le mea lena na e tofia o se Siona mo lou nuu.

verses.en: And if it cannot be otherwise, that the cause of thy people may not fail before thee may thine anger be kindled, and thine indignation fall upon them, that they may be wasted away, both root and branch, from under heaven;
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē mafai i se isi ala, ina ia lē mafai ona iuvale o le faamoemoe o lou nuu i ou luma, ia faamumūina lou toatamai, ma pa’ū ifo lou toasa i luga o i latou, ina ia faaumatia ese i latou, o a’a atoa ma lala, mai i lalo o le lagi;

verses.en: But inasmuch as they will repent, thou art gracious and merciful, and wilt turn away thy wrath when thou lookest upon the face of thine Anointed.
verses.sm: Ae e tusa ai ma lo latou salamo, ua e agalelei ma alofa mutimutivale, ma liliu ese lou toasa pe a e silasila mai i luga o fofoga o lē ua e Faauuina.

verses.en: Have mercy, O Lord, upon all the nations of the earth; have mercy upon the rulers of our land; may those principles, which were so honorably and nobly defended, namely, the Constitution of our land, by our fathers, be established forever.
verses.sm: Ia e alofa mutimutivale, le Alii e, i luga o atunuu uma o le lalolagi; ia e alofa mutimutivale i luga o pule o lo matou atunuu; ia faatumauina e faavavau mataupu autu na, ua ta’ua, o le Tulafono Faavae a lo matou atunuu, ia puipuia lava i le mamalu ma le tamalii e o matou tamā.

verses.en: Remember the kings, the princes, the nobles, and the great ones of the earth, and all people, and the churches, all the poor, the needy, and afflicted ones of the earth;
verses.sm: Ia e manatua tupu, aloalii, tamalii, ma tagata silisili o le lalolagi, ma tagata uma, ma ekalesia, tagata matitiva uma, ma e ua lē tagolima, ma e puapuagatia o le lalolagi;

verses.en: That their hearts may be softened when thy servants shall go out from thy house, O Jehovah, to bear testimony of thy name; that their prejudices may give way before the truth, and thy people may obtain favor in the sight of all;
verses.sm: Ina ia faamaluluina o latou loto pe a o atu au auauna mai lou maota, Ieova e, e molimau atu lou suafa; ina ia aveesea o latou manatu faapito e le upumoni, ma ina ia mafai e lou nuu ona maua le fiafia mai le vaaiga a tagata uma;

verses.en: That all the ends of the earth may know that we, thy servants, have heard thy voice, and that thou hast sent us;
verses.sm: Ina ia iloa ai e tuluiga uma o le lalolagi, o i matou, o au auauna, na matou faalogo i lou siufofoga, ma ua e auina atu i matou;

verses.en: That from among all these, thy servants, the sons of Jacob, may gather out the righteous to build a holy city to thy name, as thou hast commanded them.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ai e au auauna, o atalii o Iakopo, ona faapotopoto e amiotonu mai totonu o i latou uma ia, e faatuina se aai paia i lou suafa, e pei ona e poloaiina ai i latou.

verses.en: We ask thee to appoint unto Zion other stakes besides this one which thou hast appointed, that the gathering of thy people may roll on in great power and majesty, that thy work may be cut short in righteousness.
verses.sm: Matou te ole atu ia te oe ia tofia ia Siona ni isi siteki e ese mai le tasi lenei ua e tofia, ina ia mafai ona taavale atu pea i luma i le mana ma le mamalu tele le faapotopotoina o lou nuu, ina ia mafai ona faapuupuu o lau galuega i le amiotonu.

verses.en: Now these words, O Lord, we have spoken before thee, concerning the revelations and commandments which thou hast given unto us, who are identified with the Gentiles.
verses.sm: O lenei o nei upu, le Alii e, ua matou tautala atu ai i ou luma, e faatatau i faaaliga ma poloaiga na e tuuina mai ia te i matou, o e ua faailogaina faatasi ma Nuuese.

verses.en: But thou knowest that thou hast a great love for the children of Jacob, who have been scattered upon the mountains for a long time, in a cloudy and dark day.
verses.sm: Ae ua e silafia ua i ai ia te oe se alofa tele mo le fanau a Iakopo, o e ua faataapeapeina i luga o mauga mo se taimi umi lava, i se aso auaoa ma le pouliuli.

verses.en: We therefore ask thee to have mercy upon the children of Jacob, that Jerusalem, from this hour, may begin to be redeemed;
verses.sm: O lea matou te ole atu ai ia te oe ia e alofa mutimutivale i luga o le fanau a Iakopo, ina ia mafai, mai le itula lenei, ona amata ona laveaiina o Ierusalema;

verses.en: And the yoke of bondage may begin to be broken off from the house of David;
verses.sm: Ma ia mafai ona amata ona gausia o le amo o le pologa mai le fale o Tavita;

verses.en: And the children of Judah may begin to return to the lands which thou didst give to Abraham, their father.
verses.sm: Ma ia mafai ona amata e le fanau a Iuta ona toe foi atu i laueleele na e tuuina mai ia Aperaamo, lo latou tamā.

verses.en: And cause that the remnants of Jacob, who have been cursed and smitten because of their transgression, be converted from their wild and savage condition to the fulness of the everlasting gospel;
verses.sm: Ma faia ia faaliliuina vaega o totoe o Iakopo, o e na fetuuina ma taia ona o lo latou solitulafono, mai lo latou tulaga lē taupulea ma lē aoaoina, i le atoatoaga o le talalelei tumau e faavavau;

verses.en: That they may lay down their weapons of bloodshed, and cease their rebellions.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona latou tuu i lalo a latou auupega o le faamasaatoto, ma tuu a latou fouvalega.

verses.en: And may all the scattered remnants of Israel, who have been driven to the ends of the earth, come to a knowledge of the truth, believe in the Messiah, and be redeemed from oppression, and rejoice before thee.
verses.sm: Ma talosia ia o mai vaega uma o totoe o Isaraelu ua faataapeapeina, o e na tulia i tuluiga o le lalolagi, i se malamalama o le upumoni, ma talitonu i le Mesia, ma laveai mai le sauā, ma olioli i ou luma.

verses.en: O Lord, remember thy servant, Joseph Smith, Jun., and all his afflictions and persecutions—how he has covenanted with Jehovah, and vowed to thee, O Mighty God of Jacob—and the commandments which thou hast given unto him, and that he hath sincerely striven to do thy will.
verses.sm: E, le Alii e, ia e manatua lau auauna, o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma ona puapuaga ma sauaga uma— le ala na osifeagaiga ai o ia ma Ieova, ma tauto atu ai ia te oe, le Atua Malosi Aoao e o Iakopo— ma poloaiga ua e tuuina mai ia te ia, ma ua taumafai lava o ia ma le faamaoni e fai lou finagalo.

verses.en: Have mercy, O Lord, upon his wife and children, that they may be exalted in thy presence, and preserved by thy fostering hand.
verses.sm: Ia e alofa mutimutivale mai, le Alii e, i lana avā ma lana fanau, ina ia mafai ona faaeaina i latou i ou luma, ma faasaoina e lou aao tausi.

verses.en: Have mercy upon all their immediate connections, that their prejudices may be broken up and swept away as with a flood; that they may be converted and redeemed with Israel, and know that thou art God.
verses.sm: Ia e alofa mutimutivale i o latou aiga valalata uma, ina ia fatia o latou manatu faapito ma tafi ese e faapei ona faia i se lolo; ina ia mafai ona faaliliu mai ma togiola i latou faatasi ma Isaraelu, ma iloa o oe lava o le Atua.

verses.en: Remember, O Lord, the presidents, even all the presidents of thy church, that thy right hand may exalt them, with all their families, and their immediate connections, that their names may be perpetuated and had in everlasting remembrance from generation to generation.
verses.sm: Ia e manatua, le Alii e, peresitene, peresitene uma lava o lau ekalesia, ina ia mafai e lou aao taumatau ona faaeaina i latou, faatasi ma o latou aiga uma, ma o latou aiga valalata, ina ia mafai ona faatumauina ma manatua pea o latou igoa e faavavau mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: Remember all thy church, O Lord, with all their families, and all their immediate connections, with all their sick and afflicted ones, with all the poor and meek of the earth; that the kingdom, which thou hast set up without hands, may become a great mountain and fill the whole earth;
verses.sm: Ia e manatua lau ekalesia atoa, le Alii e, ma o latou aiga uma, ma o latou aiga valalata uma, faatasi ma o latou tagata mamai ma puapuagatia uma, faatasi ma e matitiva ma agamalu uma o le lalolagi; ina ia mafai ona avea o le malo, lea ua e faatuina e aunoa ma lima, o se mauga tele ma faatumu ai le lalolagi atoa;

verses.en: That thy church may come forth out of the wilderness of darkness, and shine forth fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners;
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona sau o lau ekalesia nai le vao o le pouliuli, ma susulu malamalama atu e pei o le masina, manino e pei o le la, ma mata’utia e pei o se autau ma tagavai;

verses.en: And be adorned as a bride for that day when thou shalt unveil the heavens, and cause the mountains to flow down at thy presence, and the valleys to be exalted, the rough places made smooth; that thy glory may fill the earth;
verses.sm: Ma teuteuina e pei o se faatoanofotane mo lena aso pe a e afe le veli o le lagi, ma faia mauga ia soloi i lalo i ou luma, ma vanu ia siitia, ma faalauleleia mea gaoā; ina ia faatumuina le lalolagi i lou mamalu;

verses.en: That when the trump shall sound for the dead, we shall be caught up in the cloud to meet thee, that we may ever be with the Lord;
verses.sm: Ina a oo ina ilia le pu mo e ua oti, ia segia a’e ai i matou i luga i le ao e fetaia’i ma oe, ina ia matou faatasi e faavavau ma le Alii;

verses.en: That our garments may be pure, that we may be clothed upon with robes of righteousness, with palms in our hands, and crowns of glory upon our heads, and reap eternal joy for all our sufferings.
verses.sm: Ina ia mamā o matou ofu, ina ia mafai ona faaofuina o i matou i ofu talaloa o le amiotonu, ma laupama i o matou lima, ma pale o le mamalu i luga o o matou ulu, ma selesele le olioli e faavavau mo o matou puapuaga uma.

verses.en: O Lord God Almighty, hear us in these our petitions, and answer us from heaven, thy holy habitation, where thou sittest enthroned, with glory, honor, power, majesty, might, dominion, truth, justice, judgment, mercy, and an infinity of fulness, from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.sm: E, le Alii e le Atua Malosi Aoao, faafofoga mai ia te i matou ia matou nei olega, ma tali mai ia i matou mai le lagi, lou afioaga paia, i le mea o loo e afio ai i lou nofoalii, ma le mamalu, viiga, mana, malualii, malosi, puleaga, upumoni, faimeatonu, faamasinotonu, alofa mutimutivale, ma se āoāo lē gata o le atoatoaga, mai le faavavaue tumau i le faavavau e tumau.

verses.en: O hear, O hear, O hear us, O Lord! And answer these petitions, and accept the dedication of this house unto thee, the work of our hands, which we have built unto thy name;
verses.sm: E, faafofoga mai ia, E, faafofoga mai ia, E, faafofoga mai ia ia te i matou, le Alii e! Ma tali mai i nei olega, ma talia le faapaiaga o lenei fale mo oe, o le galuega a o matou lima, lea na matou fausia i lou suafa;

verses.en: And also this church, to put upon it thy name. And help us by the power of thy Spirit, that we may mingle our voices with those bright, shining seraphs around thy throne, with acclamations of praise, singing Hosanna to God and the Lamb!
verses.sm: Ma lenei foi ekalesia, ia tuu i ai i luga lou suafa. Ma fesoasoani mai ia te i matou i le mana o lou Agaga, ina ia matou tuufaatasi o matou leo ma i latou o serafi pupula ma susulu na o loo siomia ai lou nofoalii, ma alaga o viiga, o pepese atu Osana i le Atua ma le Tamai Mamoe!

verses.en: And let these, thine anointed ones, be clothed with salvation, and thy saints shout aloud for joy. Amen, and Amen.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu mai ia i latou nei, o ou tagata faauuina, ia faaoofuina i le olataga, ma alalaga leotetele lau au paia i le olioli. Amene, ma Amene.
